protocol_title: Cross-Domain Blind Architecture Validation for GPCR, Ion Channel, Kinase/Protease, and IDP Systems

global_governance.goal: Produce an externally shareable, preregistered cross-domain architecture validation bundle suitable for preprint-era scrutiny.
anti_leakage_rules: No target/ligand/control swapping after protocol freeze.
No acceptance-threshold changes after protocol freeze except explicit diagnostic-only annotations already encoded here.
No candidate-specific relabeling for IDP corrected evaluation; frozen-label sources are taken from the current release manifest.
Smoke ligand runs use stage5_ranking_eval plus stage45_eval_integrity as the acceptance basis when the only stage6 failure is ranking_eval_unique_keys at n=64.
reporting_rules: Each set must publish raw task outputs, manifest.json, manifest.md, copied artifact files, and a zip bundle.
Each task records raw pass, effective pass, run return code, and acceptance note when diagnostic overrides are used.
Historical current baseline references are recorded in the protocol and copied into the submission package.
claim_scope: Primary claims use full blind/core and expanded OOD sets.
Operational smoke is reproducibility support, not the primary large-scale performance claim.
For IDP, release claims use all_fold_pass plus regression pass; combined_gate_pass is reported but interpreted using branch-conditioned combined metrics.

sets.title: Core Blind Set
sets.purpose: Primary cross-domain blind performance set across GPCR, ion channel, kinase/protease, and the current full IDP release.
sets.preregistered_claim: Primary performance claim set for bioRxiv-facing architecture validation.

acceptance_policy.ligand_rule: use task-level pass from produced stress summary
acceptance_policy.idp_rule: use current release acceptance from manifest

sets.title: Expanded OOD Set
sets.purpose: Broader OOD stress set for the same four domains using larger public blind expansions and strict external-style kinase evaluation.
sets.preregistered_claim: Secondary generalization claim set for out-of-distribution validation.

acceptance_policy.ligand_rule: use task-level pass from produced stress summary
acceptance_policy.idp_rule: use current release acceptance from manifest

sets.title: Operational Smoke Set
sets.purpose: Fast reproducibility support set used to demonstrate that the architecture survives small reruns across the same four domains.
sets.preregistered_claim: Operational reproducibility support set, not the primary large-scale claim set.

acceptance_policy.set_pass_rule: all tasks pass after smoke-specific ligand acceptance logic
acceptance_policy.ligand_smoke_rule: if stage5_ranking_eval ok, stage45_eval_integrity ok, and the only stage6 failure is ranking_eval_unique_keys at n=64, treat the run as an accepted smoke pass while preserving raw_pass=false
acceptance_policy.idp_rule: use fresh current smoke rerun output
